Context graph
Trail
Help agents solve the most complex problems with
context graphs.
A customer send an email asking to
return an order past the 30-day window
, bought under
an enterprise agreement
, after
three prior returns this quarter
, and
their rep promised an exception on a call
.
Do we accept it?
One single email requires five different kinds of context, each owned by a different team. The returns policy doesn’t know the call, the ERP doesn’t know the agreement, and so on.
Our context graph, Trail, holds every rule cited to the document it came from.
How Trail, our context graph, works →
Returns policy
Policy context
➔
What is allowed?
30 days, so exceptions need a manager.
ERP order record
System-of-record context
➔
What did they buy?
SO-4471 is the enterprise agreement, dated 62 days ago.
Return history
Computed context
➔
How often is this?
There were 3 returns this quarter, $84K in total.
Call notes & email
Conversation context
➔
What was promised?
Rep agreed an exception on 4 Aug.
Exception SOP
SOP context
➔
Who approves, in what order?
Support lead → finance, logged on the order.
Most teams have already automated 20-40%.
Nanonets takes you to 95%.
40%
95%
Trail:
Context Graphs
Trail converts your enterprise policies, procedures, systems, and institutional knowledge into a governed graph for AI.
01
Import your documentation
Drop in the SOP, policy docs, and other forms of documentation of your business processes. A PDF / DOCX upload or simply a set of instructions.

Claims Adjudication — Auto & Property
Confidential
Standard Operating Procedure
Purpose
Adjudicate each first-notice-of-loss claim against the active policy. Return a decision, the payable amount, and a rationale.
1. Coverage & eligibility
The deductible is applied before any payable amount is calculated.
2. Documentation requirements
Water damage — dated photos and a plumber's report.
Bodily injury — an itemized medical bill.
